confidence_notes: Beer, coffee, and the inexpensive and mid-range meal anchors rest on aggregated Numbeo-derived averages republished by Expatica (June 2026), cross-checked against Expat Arrivals and MyLifeElsewhere snapshots, so they are reasonably reliable. The cocktail and wine glass are less certain: the cocktail draws on Expatistan's club-based GBP 9 figure and Cities Insider's GBP 8-12 range, and the wine glass is inferred from Cities Insider's GBP 5-8 glass range, Numbeo's mid-range bottle price, and the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July 2026 summer window from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. No GBP/USD rate was retrieved, so GBP amounts were converted at an assumed 1.30 USD per GBP, which adds uncertainty to every USD value. The FX observation (0.6720 for 2026-11-18) comes from search summaries of the RBA exchange-rates overview page and was not checked against the F11.1 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink basis is Cardiff-specific aggregated price data for the UK city. Cocktail and wine glass are inferred from local bar and bottle ranges and the beer relationship. Accommodation is benchmarked holistically against mid-sized UK regional cities with summer tourism demand, without checking current listings.
